title: Comment on “Enamel matrix derivative in the prevention and treatment of medication-related osteonecrosis of the jaws in rats”
html: We commend Eren et al. for their well-designed study, which investigates the potential role of enamel matrix derivative (EMD) in the prevention and treatment of medication-related osteonecrosis of the jaws (MRONJ) in a rat model1. Through histological, immunohistochemical, and micro-computed tomography analyses, the authors convincingly show that EMD promotes mucosal healing, stimulates angiogenesis, and facilitates bone regeneration. Their findings provide valuable insights into the use of a biologically active regenerative agent for this debilitating complication of anti-resorptive therapy.
